title: Lazy loading and prefetching
description: Learn about Lazy loading and prefetching. Master the concepts, patterns, and best practices.

data.text: Lazy loading and prefetching are powerful techniques for optimizing resource loading. Lazy loading defers loading of non-critical resources until they're needed, while prefetching loads resources proactively before they're required. Together, they significantly improve perceived performance and user experience.

Lazy loading is a design pattern that delays the initialization of resources until they are actually needed. This reduces initial page load time, saves bandwidth, and improves performance, especially on mobile devices with limited resources.

data.text: Prefetching proactively loads resources that will likely be needed soon. This reduces perceived latency when users actually need those resources. Prefetching should be used strategically for high-confidence predictions.

data.title: DNS Prefetching
data.content: Prefetch DNS lookups for external domains.
data.code:
<!-- Prefetch DNS for external domains -->
<link rel="dns-prefetch" href="https://cdn.example.com">
<link rel="dns-prefetch" href="https://api.example.com">

<!-- Preconnect for even faster connections -->
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://cdn.example.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://api.example.com">

data.title: Resource Prefetching
data.content: Prefetch resources that will be needed soon.
data.code:
<!-- Prefetch next page's resources -->
<link rel="prefetch" href="/next-page.js" as="script">
<link rel="prefetch" href="/next-page.css" as="style">
<link rel="prefetch" href="/hero-image.jpg" as="image">

<!-- Prerender the next page -->
<link rel="prerender" href="/next-page">

data.content: Prefetch route when user hovers over link.

data.title: Network Awareness
data.text: Be considerate of users on metered connections. Use the Network Information API to detect slow connections and disable aggressive prefetching.

data.title: Network-Aware Prefetching
data.content: Adapt prefetching behavior based on network conditions.

terms.definition: Deferring resource loading until it's actually needed to reduce initial page load time.
Proactively loading resources before they're needed to reduce perceived latency.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Lazy loading reduces initial load time by deferring non-critical resources
Use native loading='lazy' for images and iframes when possible
React.lazy() and Suspense enable component-level code splitting
Prefetching loads resources proactively for faster subsequent interactions
Combine lazy loading and prefetching for optimal performance
Be network-aware and respectful of users on metered connections
data.takeaway: Lazy loading and prefetching are complementary techniques that, when used strategically, significantly improve both actual and perceived performance.
